summary: Israeli airstrikes targeted Hezbollah's Radwan Force in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley, striking dozens of rockets and launchers 25 kilometers from the border. Iran experienced widespread missile launches, UAV activity, and air defense engagements across multiple provinces. A senior Hamas economic official was killed in an Israeli strike in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah.
key_points: IDF confirms airstrikes near Ayn al-Tina, Beqaa Valley, hitting dozens of Hezbollah Radwan Force rockets and launchers at a training camp 25km north of the border. (Source: @manniefabian/59591)
Multiple missile launches reported from Tang-e Kenesht and Konesht Canyon in Kermanshah Province, Iran, within 18 minutes. (Source: @shin_persian/12936)
UAV activity detected over Jask, Hormozgan, and low-altitude UAV over Shiraz, Fars, both at 21:42 local time. (Source: @shin_persian/12931)
Air defense activity recorded at Ramhormoz and the 45th Brigade base in Shushtar, Khuzestan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12934)
Missile launch sounds heard in Ramshir, Khuzestan, and UAV launch from Omidiyeh, Khuzestan, early morning. (Source: @shin_persian/12943)
Hamas deputy education minister Khaled Abu Nada killed in Deir al-Balah strike alongside his wife; IDF says he managed Hamas banks and investment network. (Source: @manniefabian/59587)
ISIS attack in Hasaka, Syria kills two security personnel and wounds five others. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10449)
Iraqi federal forces close Al-Waleed crossing with Syria and Bashta crossing with Iran per Supreme Court ruling. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10448)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from Kermanshah and widespread UAV activity across Hormozgan, Fars, and Khuzestan suggest heightened readiness or testing of integrated air defense and offensive capabilities. Israeli strikes on Hezbollah's Radwan Force in the Beqaa Valley degrade the group's precision strike capacity but risk escalation given the depth of the target (25km from border). The killing of Hamas's financial chief in Gaza disrupts the group's resource allocation but may not immediately degrade military operations. ISIS's attack in Hasaka demonstrates enduring insurgent capacity in Syria despite counterterrorism efforts.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese Army conducts scheduled live-fire exercises in the south, signaling institutional continuity amid cross-border strikes. Iraqi federal assertion of border control at Al-Waleed and Bashta crossings reflects Baghdad's push to consolidate sovereignty over Kurdish-administered transit points. Flydubai's resumption of flights to Tel Aviv indicates Gulf states maintain economic normalization with Israel despite regional tensions. Red Alert Lebanon's public warning against photography highlights operational security concerns for Hezbollah and allies.
sections.intelligence_notes: The clustering of Iranian missile launches and UAV flights within a narrow time window across multiple provinces warrants monitoring for command-and-control exercises or response to perceived threats. IDF's specific targeting of Radwan Force training infrastructure suggests intelligence-driven preemption of imminent rocket threats. The closure of Iraqi-KRG crossings may disrupt smuggling routes used by Iran-backed groups. Hamas's financial leadership decapitation could force reorganization of external funding channels, potentially increasing reliance on cryptocurrency or informal networks.
